title: Phase 2a Study to Assess Safety and Efficacy of Two 177Lu-TLX250 Dosing Regimens in Advanced Relapsed or Recurrent ccRCC
official: A Phase 2a, Multi-Center, Open-Label Study to Compare Two Dosing Regimens of 177Lu-TLX250 (Lutetium (177Lu) Girentuximab Tetraxetan) in Participants With Carbonic Anhydrase IX (CAIX) Expressing, Advanced Relapsed or Recurrent Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma (ccRCC)
summary: Multicenter Phase 2A study of 177Lu-TLX250 in adult participants with CAIX-expressing advanced, relapsed or recurrent clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC). Part 1 will evaluate two dosing regimens to determine the recommended Phase 3 dose (RP3D).
